title: GKS Bundle
description: A GKS Bundle packages modular GKS objects (variants, conditions, propositions, statements) into a single shareable, schema-validated document. This is a self-contained demonstrator of the Pillar 1 packaging pattern: it uses local $defs rather than remote GA4GH $refs so the site build stays hermetic and offline-reproducible. The production bundles will compose the real remote GKS schemas.

bundleVersion.description: Semantic version of the bundle format.

source.description: The community resource that produced this bundle (e.g. ClinVar GKS, CIViC).

statements.description: The knowledge statements carried by this bundle.

Statement.title: Statement
Statement.description: An assertion that evaluates a Proposition, with a direction and strength of support.

direction.description: Whether the statement supports, disputes, or is neutral toward the Proposition.

Proposition.title: Proposition
Proposition.description: A possible fact about a subject, expressed as subject-predicate-object. GKS prescribes several specialized propositions (e.g. VariantPathogenicityProposition); a CustomProposition (a planned Pillar 2 escape hatch) fills the gap for propositions GKS does not prescribe.

subject.description: The entity the Proposition is about (e.g. a variant).

predicate.description: The relationship asserted between subject and object.

object.description: The entity related to the subject via the predicate (e.g. a condition).
